failure_summary.description: Calls mismatched parameter groups or values, including endpoint-specific codes, casing, serialization, and omitted qualifiers.
Some trajectories added an unrequested marketplace search, an overlapping search, or a redundant format-only validator.
A multi-theme request used an unsupported list encoding and omitted the match mode needed to require all requested themes.

patch.reasoning: The skill already covers schema fidelity and pruning redundant calls, so those rules should not be duplicated. These edits clarify two remaining gaps: preserving any-versus-all semantics for multi-value filters, and keeping marketplace comparisons within the sources the user named.

edits.target: Combine multiple filters or categories in one call when they concern the same operation and the endpoint supports that syntax.
edits.content: For multi-value filters, preserve whether the user asks for any listed value or for all of them to match. Use the endpoint's documented list encoding and, when available, its documented match-mode parameter; do not assume comma-separated values or an all-match mode without schema support.

edits.target: Do not fan out across generic tools or marketplaces merely because the user did not specify a source.
edits.content: When a comparison names its retailer sources, keep comparison searches within those sources; do not add an unmentioned marketplace as an auxiliary search or suggestion source unless the user also asks for broader marketplace discovery.
